title: Treasure Island
story: Players are pirates collecting treasure and dribbling it safely home.
setup: 20x20 area, one ball per player, flat cones in the middle and four corner ships.
instructions: Start at a ship with a ball.
On sail, collect one treasure and return it.
coach_lens: Praise looking up, soft touches and clever routes, not speed alone.

low_attendance: Use one smaller area and repeat short rounds.
high_attendance: Duplicate the area so every player stays involved.
limited_equipment: Use shoes or field markings when cones or goals are unavailable.

diagram.alt: Four home ships surround a central treasure island; arrows show players dribbling between them.
